rules.name: compiles_clean
rules.evaluationHint: Run tsc --noEmit. FAIL if any errors.

rules.name: no_lint_warnings
rules.evaluationHint: Run the project linter. FAIL if any warnings or errors.

rules.name: tests_pass
rules.evaluationHint: Run test suite. FAIL if any test fails.

rules.name: no_hardcoded_secrets
rules.description: No API keys, tokens, or passwords in code
rules.evaluationHint: Search for patterns like API_KEY=, token=, password=, hardcoded URLs with credentials. FAIL if found.

rules.name: error_handling_present
rules.description: Error paths are handled, not swallowed silently
rules.evaluationHint: Check try/catch blocks and promise chains. FAIL if errors are caught but ignored.

rules.name: follows_existing_patterns
rules.description: New code follows the same patterns as surrounding code
rules.evaluationHint: Compare with adjacent files. FAIL if new abstractions or patterns diverge from established conventions.

rules.name: has_regression_test
rules.description: Every bug fix ships with a test that would have caught it
rules.evaluationHint: Check if a test exists for the specific fix. FAIL if no test covers the fixed behavior.

usage: Evaluate each rule against your target, then call run_quality_gate with gateName="code_review" and the boolean results.

_quickRef.nextAction: Evaluate each rule against your target. Then call run_quality_gate with your boolean results.
